purpose: Prioritize human review of observable interview-session events; never determine that a candidate cheated.

signals.description: Interview page becomes hidden for a sustained interval during an active timed question.
signals.candidate_warning: Your interview page appears to have become inactive. If this was accidental or caused by a device notification, you may continue.
limitations: Does not identify which app or content was opened.

signals.description: Two or more sustained page-hidden intervals within one interview section.
signals.candidate_warning: We noticed repeated interruptions to the interview page. Please let the interviewer know if you are experiencing a technical issue.
limitations: Must exclude breaks, setup, reconnects, and permitted workflows.

signals.description: Three or more blur/focus transitions within 60 seconds.
signals.candidate_warning: The interview window lost focus. This can happen because of notifications or system dialogs.
limitations: Window blur is weaker evidence than page-hidden state.

signals.description: Possible additional voice activity in the consented interview audio stream.
signals.candidate_warning: An audio event could not be interpreted reliably. Please confirm that your microphone is working as expected.
limitations: Echo, noise, overlap, TV, and household speech can cause false positives.
Never identify or transcribe background speakers.

signals.description: Repeated gaze-direction changes where visual tracking is valid.
limitations: Never infer cheating, distraction, reading answers, or deception.

signals.description: Network reconnect, device interruption, or media stream failure.
limitations: Must not be treated as malpractice.

pattern_rules.description: Repeated sustained page-hidden events during active questions, after excluding known technical and permitted events.
Multiple independent policy-relevant event types, including a separately validated possible additional voice event, within the same interview section.
pattern_rules.note: Still not proof of assistance; audio module must be separately consented and validated.
